sources: Owner confirmation 26 Sep 2026: sibling 10% second child, 15% third child

tuition.note: Per band: full-payment price, each of 2 instalments, each of 4 instalments. Instalment totals run about 3% and 5% above the full-payment price.

capital.note: Toddler-Pre-K $600, KG-Grade 12 $1,200. The PDF lists no capital fee for half-day Toddler/Nursery.

enrolment.note: Once, on acceptance. New students only.

sibling.orderRuleNote: Eldest child (highest grade) is the first child. Inferred from the register, where the older child always carries 0% and the younger 20% on the capital ladder. Confirm.
sibling.countRelationshipsNote: Only own children count toward child order. Nephews and nieces are listed in the register but nothing records whether they count. Confirm.

alumni.note: 10% tuition for the first child of Paragon or Zaman alumni. Sibling rates apply to the remaining children.

capitalLadder.note: Recorded in the register as 'Policy: 0 20% 40% 60%'. Not published on the fees page or in either PDF. Board to confirm and approve publication; until then it is computed for staff but hidden from parents.

fullPayment.stackingNote: Applied after sibling, alumni and capital-ladder discounts, to the remaining amount. The register sometimes writes it as additive ('25% + 6%'). Confirm.

delegation.note: Proposed thresholds. The Finance Committee sets the numbers.
